intro:
Welcome to PokéVoid! This is a battle-focused Pokémon fangame with roguelite elements.
$This game is not monetized and we claim no ownership of Pokémon nor of the copyrighted assets used.
$The game is a work in progress, but fully playable.
For bug reports, please use the Discord community.
$If the game runs slowly, please ensure 'Hardware Acceleration' is turned on in your browser settings.
menu:
From this menu you can access the settings.
$From the settings you can change game speed, window style, and other options.
$There are also various other features here, so be sure to check them all!
starterSelect:
From this screen, you can select your starters by pressing
Z or the Space bar. These are your initial party members.
$Each starter has a value. Your party can have up to
6 members as long as the total does not exceed 10.
$You can also select gender, ability, and form depending on
the variants you've caught or hatched.
$The IVs for a species are also the best of every one you've
caught or hatched, so try to get lots of the same species!
pokerus:
A daily random 3 selectable starters have a purple border.
$If you see a starter you own with one of these,
try adding it to your party. Be sure to check its summary!
statChange:
Stat changes persist across battles as long as your Pokémon aren't recalled.
$Your Pokémon are recalled before a trainer battle and before entering a new biome.
$You can view the stat changes for any Pokémon on the field by holding C or Shift.
$You can also view the moveset for an enemy Pokémon by holding V.
$This only reveals moves that you've seen the Pokémon use this battle.
selectItem:
After every battle, you are given a choice of 3 random items.
You may only pick one.
$These range from consumables, to Pokémon held items, to passive permanent items.
$Most non-consumable item effects will stack in various ways.
$Some items will only show up if they can be used, such as evolution items.
$You can also transfer held items between Pokémon using the transfer option.
$The transfer option will appear in the bottom right once you have obtained a held item.
$You may purchase consumable items with money, and a larger variety will be available the further you get.
$Be sure to buy these before you pick your random item, as it will progress to the next battle once you do.
eggGacha:
From this screen, you can redeem your vouchers for
Pokémon eggs.
$Eggs have to be hatched and get closer to hatching after
every battle. Rarer eggs take longer to hatch.
$Hatched Pokémon also won't be added to your party, they will
be added to your starters.
$Pokémon hatched from eggs generally have better IVs than
wild Pokémon.
$Some Pokémon can only even be obtained from eggs.
$There are 3 different machines to pull from with different
bonuses, so pick the one that suits you best!
backupReminder:
Please backup your save by downloading it to your device.
$This will help prevent you from starting all over again should your browser data be lost.

accessMenu.title: Accessing the Menu
accessMenu.text: To access the menu, press M or Escape while awaiting input. The menu contains settings and various features.

pokerogue.title: Giving PokéRogue The Credit It Deserves

text.1: Without PokéRogue's brilliant design, PokéVoid wouldn't be here today! Their extendable framework let me experiment, BREAK, and make PokéVoid what it is today!
text.2: Where PokéRogue stands as a shining beacon of what a Pokémon roguelike should be...
text.3: PokéVoid attempts to venture into the shadows, bringing a touch of beautiful chaos and corruption to their near-perfect formula.
text.4: If you love daily runs, events, challenge modes? Endless or Splice modes? Visit pokerogue.net and play the original!

text.1: With each purchase the shop inventory changes! Use it to your advantage, and be sure to get what you need first!
text.2: Keep an eye out for FREE items, they randomly appear in the shop's inventory!

text.1: Press R to view the current run details immediately (when you're in the battle / rewards / title screen)
Past Rivals you defeated echo from the void, these beings are not what they seem.
text.2: Corrupted entities twisted by the void, their true form lies in wait for you in the void. Save them.

text.1: You can now upgrade moves with a TON of different upgrades!
text.2: Upgrade a move's priority, POWER, effect, chance, multi hit status, and more!
text.3: Each upgrade has it's own Upgrade Path with multiple Tiers!
text.4: Upgrades can make ANY move absolutely game breaking! HOWEVER - each upgrade starts at the lowest tier 1 (weak).
text.5: By continuously upgrading a move, you can make even the weakest move LEGENDARY!

text.1: Choose one upgrade, and for the whole run that move will be upgraded for everyone, including your team, and even your enemies!
text.2: Since you can upgrade almost any move, some combinations will not work or break the game, unfortunately with the scale of this update, this is unavoidable.
text.3: If this happens, please refresh and choose a different upgrade combination.
text.4: If you find a combination that doesn't work, please join discord and add it to the list of broken combinations!
text.5: Please note that Moves can only have ONE effect chance (i.e. 10% chance to paralyze), so upgrades EITHER directly change the effect chance, OR use the previous chance value!
text.6: Lastly, Upgrades can overwrite each other, the newest upgrade gets priority!

text.1: PokéVoid lets you make ANY Pokémon legendary!
text.2: By using Glitch Items you can make Pokemon have new abilities, types, moves, stats, and more!
text.3: The Void awaits, Trainer. Embrace the forbidden power to overcome it!

text.1: Each run features a random rival with a themed team and signature Pokémon!
text.2: Defeat them to unlock Glitch Quests for NEW Pokémon forms!

stats.title: Checking Your Stats
stats.text: To see your game stats, access the menu and select 'Stats'. This will show you your total battles, wins, money, and other stats!

text.1: See info on your past teams! Access via the menu and select 'Run History'.
text.2: This will show you your previous runs, including your team, items, results, and more!

rivalQuests.title: Glitch Quests
rivalQuests.text: Defeat rivals to unlock Glitch Quests! Purchase these from the OmegaShop and complete them to permanently unlock powerful Glitch Forms for specific Pokémon!

text.1: Meet Smitom, a special Rotom in Smitty form! He's a guide and a mystery...
text.2: Interact with him when an exclamation mark appears or save your game for potential rewards.

text.1: Unlock over 150 new Glitch and Smitty evolutions!
text.2: Glitch forms are unlocked via Rival Quests, unlocking Smitty forms is a mystery...

text.1: PokéVoid is in Beta! If you find a bug, please report it on the Discord.
text.2: Include a screenshot of your console (control+i in chrome) and your save file if possible. Your feedback helps improve the game!

unlockJourney.title: Unlock Journey Mode By Catching Pokemon

text.1: Journey Mode becomes available after catching 15 Pokémon, and lets you select your starting team from your collected Pokémon!
text.2: After catching your first pokemon, go to the SHOP and get the Starter Catch Quest to offically begin the Journey Unlock Quest!

text.1: Hatching eggs is a powerful way to strengthen your team! Unlike wild catches, hatched Pokémon join your starter pool with superior IVs!
text.2: Eggs are also the only way to obtain certain rare Pokémon species! Making them essential for completing your collection!
text.3: To use Egg Vouchers, simply press ESC or M to open the menu and select Egg Gacha!

text.1: Check your hatched Pokémon and if desired, swap 1 for one of your party members!
text.2: Only restrictions are your first Pokémon can't be swapped, and legendaries can only be swapped with legendaries, Megas, or Dynamaxed Pokémon!

nuzlight.title: Nuzlight Mode
nuzlight.text: A lighter version of Nuzlocke with no permanent Pokémon loss. No healing items available in shops! Fainted Pokémon revive after reaching wave 10 milestones.

nuzlocke.title: Nuzlocke Mode
nuzlocke.text: Traditional Nuzlocke challenge rules apply. Fainted Pokémon are permanently removed from your party.

text.1: Assemble your team to take on The Void. Use any Pokémon you've caught or hatched, including fusions!
text.2: Fusion Pokémon require ΩGOLD to use. OmegaItems can reduce costs and increase your starter limit.

rogueMode.title: Rogue Mode
rogueMode.text: Draft 2 random pokemon to start your run with! Use your ΩGOLD to reroll your options! Each run is unique!

bosses.title: Multi-Form Bosses
bosses.text: Beware of powerful multi-form bosses! They change form and fully heal at low HP, resetting stat changes. Defeat them for valuable rewards!

text.1: Master over 400 new abilities from 150+ Glitch and Smitty Pokémon transformations!
text.2: New game modes expand the abilities obtainable from items, including powerful Glitch abilities that can redefine battles.

text.1: Grants your pokemon a passive ability, providing an extra ability!
text.2: These do not stack, so if you get a second one, it WILL replace the first one!

text.1: Collect Glitch Pieces to get reality-altering Glitch Items! Need 2+ pieces for Glitch Items, 5+ for Glitch Form Change items.
text.2: Items include AnyTMs, Ability Swappers, Type Changers, Stat Swaps, and more!

text.1: All Fusion Pokémon are catchable and permanently added to your collection!
text.2: Find them with a base 1/14 chance (improvable with ΩITEMS). Using them costs ΩGOLD.

text.1: Most trainers will sell their Pokémon during battle (except Rivals!). Caught Pokémon are added permanently to your collection!
text.2: The cost depends on the wave but can be reduced with ΩITEMS.

text.1: Obtainable via the Shop, these expensive abilities apply to ALL Pokémon in your current party during a run!
text.2: Use powerful team-wide effects: Speed Boost or Technician for everyone!

text.1: Earn persistent ΩGOLD between runs! Use it to buy ΩITEMS, reroll Rogue starters, or pay the Fusion Tax.
text.2: Get it from bounties, rewards, saving, or Smitom interactions.

text.1: If your data is lost it's GONE FOREVER! Use the floppy disk icon (top-right) to EXPORT your save file often!
text.2: This rewards ΩGOLD and protects against data loss.

discord.title: Discord & Support
discord.text: Join the Smittyverse Discord for discussion, bug reports, and community! Find bounty codes and connect with other players.

text.1: Create unique Pokémon transformations using specific combinations of FOUR Smitty items!
text.2: Some require a specific base Pokémon (e.g., Rotom -> Smitom)
text.3: Others are Universal, so any base Pokémon can be used! (e.g., Caterpie -> Picklisk). All gain a random passive ability.

text.1: You've unlocked a new Smitty form! Each smitty form is different!
text.2: But ALL need a unique combination of 4 Smitty items!
text.3: The combination is identified via the console, find the SMITTY form's code and enter it to see the forbidden recipe!

text.1: Use ΩGOLD to buy long-lasting upgrades (ΩITEMS) with different duration types: Usage-based (quantity reduced after use) or Wave-based (quantity reduced after wave 50).
text.2: These upgrades can boost shiny/fusion/catch rates, lower costs, and provide other long-lasting benefits!

abilitySwitcher.title: Glitch: Ability Switcher
abilitySwitcher.text: Swap a Pokémon's current ability with one of its other ones! Requires 2 Glitch Pieces.

typeSwitcher.title: Glitch: Type Switchers
typeSwitcher.text: Change a Pokémon's primary AND secondary types. Requires 2 Glitch Pieces.

primarySwitcher.title: Glitch: Primary Type Switcher
primarySwitcher.text: Change a Pokémon's primary type. Requires 2 Glitch Pieces.

secondarySwitcher.title: Glitch: Secondary Type Switcher
secondarySwitcher.text: Change a Pokémon's secondary type. Requires 2 Glitch Pieces.

text.1: Release a Pokémon to grant it's typing, moves, abilities, or a stat boost to another.
text.2: Alternatively, spend 5 'Essences' from a Pokémon instead of releasing it.

anyTMs.title: Glitch: AnyTMs
anyTMs.text: These TMs can teach their move to ANY Pokémon, ignoring normal compatibility rules. Requires 2 Glitch Pieces.

anyAbilities.title: Glitch: Ability Item
anyAbilities.text: Change a Pokémon's current ability to another ability! Requires 2 Glitch Pieces.

statSwitchers.title: Glitch: Stat Switchers
statSwitchers.text: Swap two of a Pokémon's base stats (e.g., Attack and Defense). Requires 2 Glitch Pieces.

newQuests.title: New Quest Unlocked!
newQuests.text: You've unlocked a new quest! It will appear RANDOMLY (but often) in the OmegaShop / Shop on the title screen! If it's not there, reroll for it!

modeUnlocks.title: GameMode Unlocks
modeUnlocks.text: When a game mode is unlocked, it will also unlock a ton of new items and abilities! Try to unlock them all!

firstVictory.title: It's Not Over!
firstVictory.text: Your journey is just beginning! Unlock the new game modes to dive deeper into the abyss, and unravel the mysteries of the void!

theVoidUnlocked.title: The Void Unlocked!
theVoidUnlocked.text: The Void where it all began. The source of all corruption. The true face of the void awaits...

theVoidOvertaken.title: You've Overtaken The Void!
theVoidOvertaken.text: You've become too powerful for the void to contain! Yet the corruption persists, don't let it spread, you're the only one who can keep it under control!

text.1: To Mega Evolve or Dynamax a Pokémon, you must first have the Mega Bracelet or Dynamax Band items!
text.2: Once you have one of these items, and have the appropriate pokemon, a form change item will randomly appear as a reward item!
text.3: After mega evolution or dynamaxing, the Mega Bracelet or Dynamax Band will break!

text.1: Taking inspiration from roguelike masters Slay the Spire, Inscryption, and many more, Pokevoid's CHAOS modes let you choose the path you'll take next!
text.2: Plan your path, and do your best to overcome the Chaos within the VOID!
text.3: Enter the Gauntlet! Take on wave after wave of intense encounters!
text.4: Pokerogue's OG battle style, intensively remixed with random Pokevoid madness and game breaking mechanics!
text.5: Go forth trainer, embrace the void's forbidden power, and make ANY Pokémon legendary!

text.1: ~24 months of solo dev madness means everything - every time someone like you has a blast playing this game. If my weird ideas actually work and you're having fun,
text.2: then maybe - I'm closer to my dream of becoming an actual game developer. Thank you so much for playing my chaotic, broken version of PokéRogue! - Smitty

text.1: Welcome to PokéVoid's NEW Version 2.0b Update - The COLOSSAL UPDATE!! This update brings a complete overhaul with NEW UI, Champions, Skill Trees, and much more!
text.2: Experience a complete UI revamp with new icons and improved visual design throughout the game!
text.3a: Champion of Sun, Apollo - channels his radiant power as one of the last lights pushing back the void's endless night!
text.3b: Champion of Moon, Diana - weaves moonlit threads to track the void's movements and guide others to safety!
text.4: Choose your Champion and take on the void! Each Champion has unique types, signature Pokémon, and their own skill tree!
text.5: Unlock powerful skills through your Champion's Skill Tree! Use Skill Points to purchase nodes and Tree Tokens to level up!
text.6: New chaos mode variant FTL awaits!
text.7: Six new battle commands give you more control! Access your Skill Tree, check enemies, get eggs, and more mid-battle!
text.8: Better locale handling + improved translations, and countless other features await! Dive in and discover them all!

text.1: FTL (Faster Than Light) is the new fastest chaos variant! Jump straight into the chaos!
Your first journey begins now. Use the skill tree to choose 2 Pokémon for this run.
text.2: Nodes with the Draft icon offer Pokémon. Inverted icon = a Signature Pokémon option.

text.1: Who will you choose to venture into the void! Each Champion has unique typing, signature Pokémon, and skill tree!
text.2: Collect Essences by defeating Pokémon! Essences match the defeated Pokémon's type and are used to free corrupted Champions and unlock powerful skills!
text.3: Use collected Essences to level up your Champions! Higher levels unlock more powerful skills in their Skill Trees!

text.1: Some powerful skills require special Essences: Glitch Essence and Smitty Essence! These unlock the strongest abilities!
text.2: To unlock NEW MASTER+ RARITY Corrupted Glitch Forms and Powerful Legendary Pokémon - collect glitch essences by defeating glitch pokemon!
text.3: To unlock NEW MASTER+ RARITY Forbidden Smitty Abilities and Broken Alt Builds - collect smitty essences by facing the Corruption itself!

text.1: Apollo and Diana are special Champions with RANDOMIZED types! At the start of each run, you're assigned two random types!
Most Champions have FIXED type specializations! Their entire Skill Tree and Pokémon pool revolves around their types!
text.2: Brock specializes in Ground and Rock types! His Skill Tree offers Ground and Rock TMs, boosters, and abilities!
text.3: Build your team around your Champion's types! Catch Pokémon that match to maximize your Skill Tree potential!

text.1: Skill Points are used to purchase nodes in your Skill Tree! Earned from battles, rewards, and special events!
text.2: Tree Tokens level up your Skill Tree! Each level expands your Skill tree, revealing more powerful skills deeper in the tree!

text.1: Apollo and Diana can use ALL Pokémon regardless of type! They're perfect for maximum flexibility!
text.2: Type-specialized Champions like Brock can only use Pokémon matching their affinity! Brock uses Ground and Rock types!
text.3: As new Champions you recently freed from the void's corruption, they must start fresh and rebuild their collection!
text.4: Type Champions only have access to the pokemon you catch while using them! The more you catch, the more options they'll have!

text.1: Signature Pokémon are special starters unique to each Champion! Their icons are marked with chaos potential!
text.2: Signatures can transform into Alt Builds - alternate forms with different stats, abilities, and even types! A whole new Pokémon!

text.1: PokéVoid V2 adds SIX new battle commands! Access them during battle for powerful options!
text.2: TEAM: Instantly view detailed information about your party's stats, abilities, and moves!
text.3: SKILL TREE: Access your Champion's Skill Tree mid-battle! Spend points and unlock new abilities on the fly!
text.4: CHECK: Check ANY Pokémon! Conveniently see possible abilities, forms, stat spread, and movesets!
text.5: EGGS: Get eggs from the egg gacha!
text.6: SHOP: Quick access to the shop!
text.7: MAP: View your current path within the Chaos!

skillTree.title: The Skill Tree
skillTree.1: Spend Skill Points to unlock nodes. Each one gives your run a permanent edge.
skillTree.2: The deeper you go, the stronger the rewards. I put the good stuff far away because suspense builds character.

skillTreeRogueMode.title: First Skills
skillTreeRogueMode.1: Draft 2 Pokémon for Rogue Mode. Signature Pokémon are available in one of those slots — they're built different.
skillTreeRogueMode.2: Signatures evolve through ranking up. Their rank ups appear randomly within the skilltree.

skillTreeFirstNode.title: FREE Random Bonus
skillTreeFirstNode.1: After choosing your first node, FREE nodes appear!
skillTreeFirstNode.2: FREE — like this game! 3 years of life. Smitty could have made an indie game for sure in that time.
skillTreeFirstNode.3: Oh smitty, my sweet summer child, didn't you say this'll only take 6 months tops?
skillTreeFirstNode.5: Smitty blink twice if you need help...
skillTreeFirstNode.7: But yeah the nodes are free! yay free nodes!

skillTreeGlitchFormNode.title: Sealed Glitch Form
skillTreeGlitchFormNode.1: Collect enough skills and you'll unlock the sealed node — giving you access to a Glitch Form for this run!

skillTreeQuestNode.title: Side Quest!
skillTreeQuestNode.1: Quest Nodes are mini-missions that last one run. Complete them for rare drops.
skillTreeQuestNode.2: Every run brings new quests. Different goals, different loot.

championSelect.title: Choose Your Champion
championSelect.1: Each Champion wields different types, Pokémon, and forbidden skills torn from the void. Who you pick changes everything.
championSelect.2: Some Champions are still sealed away by the Void. Collect Essences to break them free.

championSelectSkills.title: Forbidden Skills
championSelectSkills.1: Skills born from your Champion's time in the darkness. Each one appears randomly in the Skill Tree during runs.
championSelectSkills.2: The corruption that made them suffer now fuels their growth. Collect Essences from fallen Pokémon to level up and gain new skills!

modifier.title: Items & Modifiers
modifier.1: Items can be combined and upgraded!
modifier.2: Keep an eye out for rare modifiers.

starterSelect.title: Infinite Fusion Called...
starterSelect.1: They want you to think it's just signatures and legendaries. But look closer. The fusions. They're INFINITE.
starterSelect.2: *swirls their metaphorical finger at you, like a crazy gorilla* Do you understand what that means?
starterSelect.3: It means every possible combination exists. EVERY. Kenney Rogers. ONE. Somebody had to make them all. Or... something did...

tutorialBattleType.title: Type Override!
tutorialBattleType.1: Bad type match-up! Use the void's power to change our type — the rules of nature don't apply here anymore.

tutorialBattleHeal.title: New Void Abilities
tutorialBattleHeal.1: Set this as our passive — HP regeneration each turn. Staying alive is step one of winning. Usually.

tutorialBattleXM.title: The Forbidden Moveset
tutorialBattleXM.1: Quickly use the void's corruption to your advantage! Embrace the forbidden power to teach your pokemon any move.

tutorialBattleGlitchReward.title: VOID ALERT
tutorialBattleGlitchReward.1: This isn't good! Quickly take {{pokemonName}}'s glitch form from the VOID!

tutorialBattleEvolveGlitch.title: EVOLVE!
tutorialBattleEvolveGlitch.1: NOW EVOLVE {{pokemonName}} to ITS NEW GLITCH FORM!!

accessMenu.title: Where the Magic Happens
accessMenu.1: M or Escape opens the menu. Settings, features, and things I filed under 'miscellaneous' because naming things is hard. Without a doubt, there's an answer to at least one question you haven't asked yet.

pokerogue.title: Shoulders On Giants Standing
pokerogue.1: Without PokéRogue this wouldn't doesn't exist. That's not flattery, that's fact. PokéRogue CREATED the brilliant framework, brilliant game. PokéVoid is what happens when you give that framework to someone with too many ideas. They walked so we could run. Into the void. At full speed. Without looking. They're the foundation. We're the mansion built on top. A haunted mansion. With too many rooms. Pokerogue.net for the original. Pokevoid.com for the remix.

intrashop.title: Five Finger Discount!?
intrashop.1: The shop restocks with every transaction. You're not just buying items, you're creating new options.
intrashop.2: Randomly free items will just appear out of nowhere! Similar to Smitty's dad when he needed money from Smitty's mom.

runDetails.title: Think About The Children
runDetails.1: R pulls up run details faster than explaining your build out loud. Useful for you. Also useful for your future self and your future children.

glitchRivals.title: Mutant Lizards from the Deep!
glitchRivals.1: Your old battles echo forward as corrupted rematches. Think of these corrupted shadows as seeds the void replanted upside down. What blooms is recognizable and wrong in interesting ways.

moveUpgrades.title: Create Your Own Moves
moveUpgrades.1: Nothing in your moveset is finished until you say so. Give Drain Punch +1 priority, Water Pulse +30 POW, Ice Beam 50% freeze chance, Change Body Slam to be a Ice move, or even a Special Attack!
moveUpgrades.2: Each new upgrade further strengthens your move.

rivals.title: The Run's Boss!
rivals.1: The world's greatest heroes are locked away deep within the void! Their corrupted shadows are your run's randomized boss encounter. Each run you'll face a different rival!
rivals.2: Beat the run → Unlock their Glitch Quests → Get their exclusive GLITCH forms!

stats.title: Your Void Level
stats.1: Check Your Stats via the menu (M or escape key). Your wins, your earnings, your items. The summary of your entire journey so far. It tracks pretty cool stuff — fights won, money earned, items obtained, and much more. Worth peeking at.

runHistory.title: That One Run Though
runHistory.1: Use Menu (M / Escape) -> Run History to view past runs and teams
runHistory.2: Looking back helps you look forward. Enjoy how far you've come since run number one.

rivalQuests.title: Go GET Your NEW FORM!
rivalQuests.1: A rival falls. A NEW GLITCH QUEST unlocks within the Omega Shop. Complete it and get a new Glitch Form. Permanently.

smitom.title: Main Character (Unpaid)
smitom.1: Part guide, part ghost, part emotional support NPC. Truthfully, I auditioned for the main character role, but the discord shot me down, so I got narrator with benefits
smitom.2: Click me when you see the ! to get rewards. Also Saving = rewards. Both trigger my sense of purpose.

newForms.title: 150 FINAL FORMS (NOT CLICKBAIT)
newForms.1: Smitty added new evolutions the way some people add cats— gradually, then all at once, then suddenly you're living in a cat infested jungle. Meowth, amiright. There's 150+ new pokemon evolutions, Each with 3 new pokevoid abilities.
newForms.2: With 150 new evolutions, at least one of your favorites probably has a new form
newForms.3: Unlock them permanently by defeating rivals and completing quests.
newForms.4: PRO TIP: The skill tree lets you steal one from the void for use during your run.

unlockJourney.title: Strawberry, Chocolate, and Berries
unlockJourney.1: To UNLOCK Journey Mode just catch 5 Pokémon. That's it. Journey mode gives you immediate access to all catches, hatches, and fusions!
unlockJourney.2: The dream team factory opens and the factory never closes. I would know, I'm the night shift manager. No days off. Forced to dream all day long, please pity me and send me decorated baskets of fruit.

discord.title: The Resistance
discord.1: Persona Social links are pretty nifty. Pretty nifty. Yep. You know what's just like social links - our discord. It's the meeting ground for void champions - the Resistance! Join us by pressing the Discord option on the title screen!

fusionPokemon.title: Infinite Fusions!
fusionPokemon.1: Fusion Pokémon are like the void's shinies — RARE to find the same one twice, catch once, own forever.
fusionPokemon.2: Fusions reward collectors who play the long con. Permanent capture. Diversifies strategy.

firstVictory.title: The Other 90 Percent
firstVictory.1: Your journey is just beginning! Unlock the new game modes to dive deeper into the abyss, and unravel the mysteries of the void!

theVoidUnlocked.title: Forbidden Message...
theVoidUnlocked.1: The Void where it all began. The source of all corruption. The true face of the void awaits...

theVoidOvertaken.title: You've Overtaken The Void!
theVoidOvertaken.1: You've become too powerful for the void to contain! Yet the corruption persists, don't let it spread, you're the only one who can keep it under control!

thankYou.title: Letter from Smitty
thankYou.1: Pokevoid has taken me roughly 3 Years of solo dev madness, it's been a truly wild ride. But it means everything - every time someone like you has a blast playing this game. If my weird ideas actually worked and you're having fun,
thankYou.2: I'm closer to my dream of becoming a full-time indie game dev. Thank you so much for playing Pokevoid! - Smitty

wave35Shared.title: NEW ITEM GET!
wave35Shared.pretext: We've found a new item in the void! {{featureName}}! Let's look up what it does on the internet.
wave35Shared.posttext: If you're feeling curious, try it out. You can also disable them in the settings, in case they dont tickle your fancy the way I tickle your fancy.

wave35StatSwitchers.1: Redistribute any Pokémon's base stats. Scyther with mage-level special attack. Machamp with speed to rival Jolteon. Gengar with thickness surpassing Snorlax! Your team, your rules. The void just handed you the admin panel. I suggest you abuse it. Preferrably irresponsibily. And yes thickness is a word, I looked it up.

wave35MoveUpgrades.1: Welcome to Move Upgrades! Make Earthquake a special attack. Give Ice Beam priority. Give Thunderbolt a freeze chance. Your moves aren't set in stone — they're set in void. You like that? I wrote it yesterday, "set in void", because we're in the void, we're not set in stone, this isn't Doctor Stone sheesh. So it makes sense. Pretty witty right. Personally I like it. Set in void sounds
wave35MoveUpgrades.3: Probably Shakespeare level if I'm honest. Well got that out of my system.

wave35ReleaseItems.1: Remember that movie where the robot says 'I'll be back'? Release Items are like that except the robot doesn't come back. Its parts go into a better robot. And that robot ALSO doesn't say 'I'll be back' because it's too busy being unstoppable. Types, stats, abilities, or moves — can be transferred! No sequel needed.

shinyPower.title: A Rare Specimen Emerges
shinyPower.1: Observe: the shiny Pokémon, upon entering its run, is presented with four paths. The first preserves its original form. Two offer new abilities paired with reshuffled stats. The final path replaces its entire moveset with type-themed attacks.
shinyPower.2: In each alternate variant, four of its stats get swapped around — a remarkable adaptation. The shiny that enters the run is rarely the same one that finishes it. Nature is healing. Specifically, the void's version of nature. Which is arguably the opposite of healing.

rankUp.title: EMBRACE or RESHAPE?
rankUp.1: My uncle collected those little shampoo bottles from hotels. Whole shelf. Never opened one. Just looked at them. Said it was investing. He's in prison now — unrelated, probably — but the principle holds. You walk through the void, you pick stuff up. Not loot, exactly. The dark energy. The corruption. The nasty film that comes off everything you beat. It doesn't vanish when you win.. You've been collecting it. Every fight adds another layer. Like lasagna, except the cheese is evil and nobody's grandmother made it.
rankUp.2: When it triggers, you get two choices - Embrace — the void's energy floods inward instead of breaking it apart. Same Pokémon, same typing, same moves, slightly darker soul. Whatever it was already strong at becomes stronger. With each Embrace the dark energy deepens, giving way to a form with shades of the void, a look the abyss would almost call its own. Reshape — where Embrace holds the form intact, Reshape shatters the boundary between species. Use the corruption to bend reality until your partner stands in a new shell, its stats get the same boost it would via Embrace, but typing and ability changes. What made them dangerous survives the reshaping. Where regular Pokémon merely endure the void's touch, Duelmons accumulate it - corruption pools in their souls until their unique Soul Surge erupts, their forbidden evolution, guaranteed to occur at certain level ranges. Regular pokemon earn soul surges randomly on level-up or through bounty rewards. Soul surges are pretty great, huh? Kind of like little shampoo bottles from hotels, my uncle would appreciate for sure.

yuMovePhase.title: Cursed Technique
yuMovePhase.1: "Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one." The void said that when it sealed your Duelmon's signature attacks in the shadow realm. Bold words from something that forgot cursed techniques can reverse. Defeat enemies with your Duelmon, level up, and POWER OF SHADOWS may unseal three forbidden moves — two from your Duelmon's own cursed pool, one from the wider shadow realm.
yuMovePhase.2: Bounties trigger Domain Expansion immediately — no level-up needed. The shadow realm isn't the prison the void thinks it is. The void just stored all the good stuff there by accident. Hollow Purple? More like Hollow Void. Your Duelmon's taking its techniques back.

altBuild.title: IMPOSSIBLE!!!
altBuild.1: IMPOSSIBLE. That power level — it's not — the scouter can't be right. Their BOND shatters every limit — their POWER boosted into two stats, typing REWRITTEN, abilities SWAPPED, movepool REPLACED, an entirely new form my equipment refuses to classify! Magikarp can become Dragonborn. Water and Dragon. FOR GOD'S SAKE — THAT'S A MAGIKARP. And it's not just the pathetic clown fish — Solrock becomes Void Constellation, Lunatone becomes Dream Weaver — THEY'RE JUST LITTLE ROCKS — ONE OF THEM IS NOT EVEN THAT ORANGE! Their BOND shattering limits I didn't know existed. These beings don't follow normal evolution — they've carved a different evolutionary path. They rank up instead. Continuously. Ten times. Not possible — no the Prince of all Saiyans WILL NOT ACCEPT THIS.
altBuild.2: And at rank ten — what IS this?! They UNLOCK NEW ABILITIES? One in a Million? Leviathan's Domain? Those aren't supposed to exist. The bond between champion and partner overrides reality itself — and there are MORE out there, every bond rewriting what these species were built for. BLAST IT ALL TO HELL! HOW CAN I, A WARRIOR OF SUPERIOR RACE, be OUTCLASSED?! KAKAROT!!!!!

smittyEncounter.title: !!!DETECTION ALERT!!!
smittyEncounter.1: Alert! Radiation signatures spiking! Self-importance readings at levels that are breaking my instruments! Scanning the source — the arrogance density alone is generating interference! Something is approaching and every metric I have says we should be terrified! Only one type of being radiates this — the type that would put themselves in their own game, give themselves a ridiculous team, and call it content.
smittyEncounter.2: Cross-referencing void signatures... this being could be the source of the Void itself. Or — re-scanning — it may be a broken piece of the Void that gained physical form. Its Pokémon aren't caught or trained. They're manifested from void energy directly. Champion, I need you to hear me: we can die here. Really die. Please be ready.

postRunWin.title: Thank You For Making It
postRunWin.1: You won. I watched the whole thing. Every close call, every smart swap, every moment where it could have gone wrong and didn't because you made it not go wrong. The void is still here but for one run, you beat it.
postRunWin.2: New modes, quests, and challenges are unlocking. The game opens up after this. But before you rush into the next thing — just know that winning a run in the void means something. It means your team was strong and your decisions were right. I'll be here for the next one. And the one after that. Now we can finally be friends. What. Why are you looking at me like that — it's like Persona, you have to spend 40 hours doing side quests before the companion trusts you. Now then, let's go hunt down some shadows — what do you say, confidant rank 1 bestie?

journeyQuestShop.title: Journey Mode Awaits!
journeyQuestShop.1: You've unlocked the Starter Catch Quest — your ticket to Journey Mode! Head to the OmegaShop to activate it.
journeyQuestShop.2: Once activated, catch 5 Pokémon across any runs to complete the quest and unlock Journey Mode!
